CanonicalVars.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign, Task 24; re-confirmed current on this stale-sweep pass, file byte-identical): all 23 cards now store their printed C# var under a `_`-attribute (or, for 3 cards whose C# var is a live/computed value at display time -- guilty, normality, expect_a_fight -- a `magic_number` property override; wither similarly overrides `base_damage`) so `Card.base_damage`/`base_block`/`base_hp_loss`/`magic_number` report the C# value instead of the 0/None default. Stampede stores the printed `DynamicVar("Power", 1m)` (Stampede.cs:15) as `self._power_amount = 1` (stampede.py:29), and `_power_amount` is in `base.py`'s `_MAGIC_ATTRS` (base.py:376), so `Card.magic_number` (base.py:412-419) now returns 1 where it previously returned None. `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:700-744) reads `card.magic_number` at line 736 into feature slot f[23], so the observation encoder now sees Stampede's Power amount. Two additive base.py changes at the time: `_frail` added to `_MAGIC_ATTRS` and a new `base_gold` property. feel_no_pain's `_block` was renamed to `_power_amount` (matches Rage/Corruption/Stampede's DynamicVar('Power', ...) convention). Combat behavior / dealt numbers are byte-identical -- a printed-number / observation-encoder fix only. CHECKPOINT NOTE for training: encoded VALUES changed for 20 of the 23 cards in feature slots f[17]/f[18] damage, f[20]/f[21] block, f[22] hp_loss, f[23] magic_number; obs LAYOUT unchanged. Pins: test/test_printed_vars.py. Same mechanism as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3) -- both now report faithful post-fix. Formerly DORMANT-for-game-fidelity / LIVE-for-observation-encoder gap; CLOSED.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<StampedePower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["Power"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Stampede.cs:24) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, StampedePower, self._power_amount, applier=ctx.player)`. No animation on either side. StampedePower's end-of-turn auto-play of a random hand Attack is the power stream's -- and it is the same end-of-turn auto-play slot card/howl_from_beyond uses, which the sim maps to `on_player_turn_end`.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `EnergyCost.UpgradeBy(-1)` (Stampede.cs:29) == `self._energy_cost = max(0, self._energy_cost - 1)` (2 -> 1). The Power var stays 1 when upgraded on both sides.
